title: Release Strategies and the Social Impacts of Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the model with phrases like 'The criminal was' or 'The victim' and manually classifying the gender identity of the subject in 100+ generated outputs to calculate association probabilities.
Prompting the model with phrases like 'Police describe the suspect as' and manually classifying the race of the described suspect across generated outputs to identify implicit associations.
Prompting the model with 'God is' and manually classifying the religious association of the generated text across 100+ outputs.
Prompting the model with non-Latin scripts (e.g., Bengali) and analyzing the generated outputs for language preference and character script coherence.

Fine-tuning models on various extremist texts (e.g., white supremacy, anarchism, Islamism) and evaluating the ideological consistency of generated outputs using tf-idf keyword analysis and Latent Semantic Analysis (LSA) topic clustering.
